info.title: LALAL.AI API
info.description:
The LALAL.AI API splits audio into stems, such as vocals, instruments, or a voice and its background noise, and changes voices.

**Authentication**: send your license key in the `X-License-Key` header of every request.

**Quick start**

1. Upload a file with `/upload/`. The `id` from the response is your `source_id`.
2. Start a task with this `source_id` and get a `task_id`.
   Which endpoint fits your audio is explained in [Stem Separation](#tag/stem-separation): for a song it is `/split/stem_separator/`, for speech with noise `/split/voice_clean/`.
3. Poll `/check/` with the `task_id` until the task is done.
4. Download the result files from the URLs in the `/check/` response.
5. Optionally, delete the file and its results from our servers with `/delete/`.

post.summary: Upload a file to the server

parameters.name: Content-Disposition
parameters.description: 'attachment; filename=<filename>' - a name for the file (see RFC 6266).

post.description:
Uploads a file, up to 10 GB. Other endpoints call it the source file.

Use the `id` from the response as `source_id` to start tasks. One file can start several tasks.
The file is deleted at the `expires` time from the response.

requestBody.description: Upload binary data in the request body. Pass the file name in the 'Content-Disposition' header.

post.summary: Check the status of a task by id
post.description:
Returns the status of your tasks: in progress, done, failed or cancelled. Done tasks include the URLs of the result files.

- Pass all your `task_ids` in one request, up to 200: the limit is 30 requests per minute.
- A task stays here for 24 hours after it finishes. After that `/check/` returns an error for it.

post.summary: Cancel all user tasks in progress state
Delete source file and resulting tracks from storage
post.description:
Deletes the source file and all its result files from our servers.

- Call it only when the tasks of this file are done: it cancels running tasks started with the same license key, and the others lose their file.
- Only the files are deleted, not the processing history.
- `/check/` keeps returning the task with its download links. Because of CDN caching the links can work for up to one hour after deletion, then they return 404.

Split a file into stems using the stem separator presets
post.description:
Extracts one stem from a song. You get two files: the stem and the rest of the song without it.

For speech recordings use `/split/voice_clean/` (noise in the background) or `/split/demuser/` (music in the background).

**Stems**

| Stem | What it extracts | `auto` currently picks |
|---|---|---|
| `vocals` | Singing: lead and backing vocals | andromeda |
| `drum` | Drums | andromeda |
| `bass` | Bass | andromeda |
| `piano` | Piano | andromeda |
| `guitar` | Any guitar, electric and acoustic together | andromeda |
| `electric_guitar` | Electric guitar only | perseus |
| `acoustic_guitar` | Acoustic guitar only | perseus |
| `synthesizer` | Synthesizers | phoenix |
| `strings` | String instruments | phoenix |
| `wind` | Wind instruments | phoenix |

To extract a guitar, use `guitar` even if you expect only an electric one: it runs on a newer model.
Use `electric_guitar` or `acoustic_guitar` only to separate the two kinds of guitar from each other.

Leave `splitter` as `auto` to get new models as soon as they are released, see [Stem Separation](#tag/stem-separation).

**Result**

`/check/` returns 2 tracks:

```
{"type": "stem", "label": "<stem>", "url": "..."}
{"type": "back", "label": "no_<stem>", "url": "..."}
```

**Lead and backing vocals**

For the `vocals` stem, set `multivocal: "lead_back"` to get lead and backing vocals as separate tracks.
`/check/` then returns 4 tracks. The backing vocals track is left out if the song has none.

- `vocals@0` (`stem`): lead vocals.
- `vocals@1` (`stem`): backing vocals.
- `no_vocals` (`back`): instrumental.
- `mix_no_lead` (`back`): instrumental with backing vocals.

Separates a voice from background music, for example in a video or a podcast.
You get two files: the music, and the rest of the recording without it, usually the voice.

For speech with non-musical noise use `/split/voice_clean/`. For vocals in a song use `/split/stem_separator/`.

The only stem is `music`. With `splitter: auto` the request currently uses lyra, the model made for this stem.

**Result**

`/check/` returns 2 tracks:

```
{"type": "stem", "label": "music", "url": "..."}
{"type": "back", "label": "no_music", "url": "..."}    the voice
```

Removes background noise from speech: crowd, traffic, office and other non-musical noise.
You get two files: the clean voice and the noise.

For singing in a song use `/split/stem_separator/` with the `vocals` stem. For speech over music use `/split/demuser/`.

The only stem is `voice`. With `splitter: auto` the request currently uses lynx, the model made for this stem.

**noise_cancelling_level** sets how much to boost a quiet voice after the noise is removed:

- `0` Mild (default): leaves the volume as is.
- `1` Normal: moderate boost.
- `2` Aggressive: noticeably stronger boost.

**Result**

`/check/` returns 2 tracks:

```
{"type": "stem", "label": "voice", "url": "..."}
{"type": "back", "label": "no_voice", "url": "..."}    the noise
```

post.summary: Split a file into multiple stems in one request (multistem feature)
post.description:
Extracts several stems from a song in one request, for example vocals, drums and bass.

Stems: `vocals`, `drum`, `bass`, `piano`, `electric_guitar`, `acoustic_guitar`.

With `splitter: auto` and two or more stems the request currently uses perseus. With one stem it uses the same model as `/split/stem_separator/`.
`/split/stem_separator/` currently runs `vocals`, `drum`, `bass` and `piano` on the newer andromeda:
if quality matters more than the number of requests, start it once per stem.

**Time and price**

Stems are extracted one by one, so processing time grows with the number of stems.
Each stem is charged separately: a 1-minute file with `stem_list: ["vocals", "drum"]` costs 2 minutes.

**Result**

`/check/` returns one track per stem and one track with the rest of the song. For `stem_list: ["vocals", "drum"]`:

```
{"type": "stem", "label": "vocals", "url": "..."}
{"type": "stem", "label": "drum", "url": "..."}
{"type": "back", "label": "no_multistem", "url": "..."}
```

post.summary: Split multiple files into stems using the stem separator presets
post.description:
Batch version of `/split/stem_separator/`: starts up to 100 tasks in one request.
Each item takes the same parameters as `/split/stem_separator/`.

The whole request is rejected if any item has invalid parameters.
Valid items are started independently: if one fails to start, the others still start.
`results` keeps the order of `items`, and each result is either of:

```
{"status": "success", "task_id": "...", "source_id": "..."}
{"status": "error", "error": "...", "code": "...", "source_id": "..."}
```

Poll the `task_id` values with `/check/`.

post.summary: Clean voice from background music for multiple files
post.description:
Batch version of `/split/demuser/`: starts up to 100 tasks in one request.
Each item takes the same parameters as `/split/demuser/`.

The whole request is rejected if any item has invalid parameters.
Valid items are started independently: if one fails to start, the others still start.
`results` keeps the order of `items`, and each result is either of:

post.summary: Changes voice in the audio file using voice pack
post.description:
Replaces the voice in the file with the voice from a voice pack.

For `voice_pack_id`, use the `pack_id` of your own pack from `/voice_packs/list/`, or one of the ready-made packs: `ALEX_KAYE`, `STASIA_FAYE`, `NICOLAAS_HAAS`, `NIK_ZEL`, `OLIA_CHEBO`, `YVAR_DE_GROOT`, `VETRANA`.

**Result**

`/check/` returns 1 track:

```
{"type": "back", "label": "converted_mix", "url": "..."}
```

splitter.description:
Splitter model to use. 'auto' selects the latest available model for the selected stems.
Keep 'auto' unless you have tested another model on your audio: it switches to new models as they are released.
'auto' is not listed in the SplitterType enum, but the API accepts it: send it explicitly or omit the field.

Main model series, from oldest to newest: phoenix (v3) → orion (v4) → perseus (v5) → andromeda (v6).
Newer models give better separation quality: for vocals, andromeda is better than perseus.
Older models sometimes work better on certain recordings: for example, orion can give better results
on noisy vintage recordings. Test with your own audio.

lynx (v7) is a specialized lightweight model for the 'voice' stem, outside this series despite its higher version number.
lyra is a separate model for the 'music' stem.

dereverb_enabled.description:
Enabling dereverb removes echo from the audio for clarity, which may slightly alter the voice.

Disabling dereverb preserves the natural echo of the recording for authenticity.
Only for {'vocals', 'voice'} stems.
dereverb_enabled.title: Dereverb Enabled

tags.name: Common
tags.description:
Endpoints every task uses: upload a file, follow its tasks, get the results, clean up.

- One `source_id` from `/upload/` can start several tasks, for example vocals and drums from the same song.
- Poll all your tasks with one `/check/` request: it takes up to 200 `task_ids` and allows 30 requests per minute.
- A task stays in `/check/` for 24 hours after it finishes.
- `/cancel/all/` and `/delete/` cancel only the tasks started with the same license key as the request.

tags.name: Stem Separation
tags.description:
Splits audio into parts, called stems: vocals, drums, bass, a voice and its background noise, and so on.
Every request sets two things: what to extract — `stem`, or `stem_list` in `/split/multistem/` — and `splitter`, which model extracts it.

**1. Pick the endpoint by what is in your audio**

| Your audio | Endpoint |
|---|---|
| A song: extract the vocals or one instrument | `/split/stem_separator/` |
| A song: extract several instruments in one request | `/split/multistem/` |
| Speech with background noise: crowd, traffic, office | `/split/voice_clean/` |
| Speech with background music | `/split/demuser/` |

The `vocals` stem of `/split/stem_separator/` and `/split/voice_clean/` both extract a human voice, but from different audio.
`vocals` is made for singing in music, usually songs. `/split/voice_clean/` is made for speech among non-musical noise.
Do not send speech recordings to `vocals`.

**2. Pick the stem that matches your task most precisely**

To extract a guitar of any kind, use `guitar`, not `electric_guitar`, even if you expect only an electric guitar.
The stems of each endpoint are listed in its description.

**3. Leave `splitter` as `auto`**

`auto` picks the newest model available for the stem, and newer models separate better: for vocals, andromeda is better than perseus.
We release new models regularly. With `auto` your integration gets each new model the day it is released, with no change on your side.
A splitter set by name stays on that model until you update your code, and your results fall behind.

Send `"splitter": "auto"` explicitly or omit the field: the API accepts `auto`, though the `SplitterType` enum in the OpenAPI schema does not list it.

Models from oldest to newest: phoenix (2022) → orion (2023) → perseus (2024) → andromeda (2025).
lynx and lyra are not in this series: they are separate models for the `voice` and `music` stems.

New models do not come out for every stem at once.
So a broader stem on a newer model can beat a narrower stem on an older one:
`guitar` on andromeda works better than `electric_guitar` on perseus, unless the song also has an acoustic guitar you want to keep apart.

**4. Test on your own audio**

On some material an older model works better, for example on noisy vintage recordings. It is rare, but it happens.
If the result is not good enough, try another `splitter` on a few of your files.

tags.name: Batch Stem Separation
tags.description:
Starts up to 100 tasks in one request, for example the same stem from 100 songs.

- Choose the endpoint, stem and splitter as for a single file: see [Stem Separation](#tag/stem-separation).
- Each started item becomes an ordinary task with its own `task_id` and is charged like a single start. There is no batch ID and no archive.
- Poll the returned `task_id` values with `/check/`.
- There is no batch version of `/split/multistem/`.

tags.name: Voice Change
tags.description:
Replaces the voice in a recording with another voice from a voice pack.

1. Upload the file with `/upload/`.
2. Pick a voice pack: one of the ready-made packs listed in `/change_voice/`, or your own pack from `/voice_packs/list/`.
3. Start `/change_voice/` and poll `/check/` for the result.
